issues.claim: Цена в том, что интерфейс остаётся веб-интерфейсом: он одинаков на всех платформах.
issues.problem: This overstates uniformity. The Blazor Hybrid page says styles in the web view are platform dependent and need custom stylesheets to cover rendering differences. The answer's own item 6 already notes that the web view engine differs per platform. The EN explanation has the same overstatement ("it looks the same on every platform").
issues.suggestedFix: RU: "он в целом одинаков на всех платформах (с поправкой на различия движков веб-вью)". EN: "it looks largely the same on every platform (allowing for web view engine differences)".

issues.claim: как вы построите решение (решение рассчитано на .NET 10)?
issues.problem: "решение" appears twice in one phrase, which reads awkwardly and is ambiguous, since it means both the decision and the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: "Что вы порекомендуете, от чего зависит выбор и как вы спроектируете архитектуру решения (целевая платформа - .NET 10)?"

issues.claim: JS-библиотеки, которые рассчитаны на браузер и сервер, - проверить заранее.
issues.problem: The phrase is vague and unnatural. The real risk is JS libraries that assume a full browser environment (browser APIs, URLs, cookies) or server-side rendering, and may misbehave in a BlazorWebView.
issues.suggestedFix: "JS-библиотеки, рассчитанные на полноценный браузер (его API, cookie, адреса страниц), - проверить в BlazorWebView заранее." Adjust the EN item 6 in the same way.

issues.claim: В .NET 9 и .NET 10 такую структуру создаёт шаблон «.NET MAUI Blazor Hybrid and Web App».
issues.problem: The fetched excerpts do not mention the template or the Linux exclusion. The template name (short name maui-blazor-web) and the lack of official Linux support are correct from general knowledge, but neither link backs them. The link only supports reuse of Razor components across mobile, desktop and web.
issues.suggestedFix: Optionally add a link to the Blazor Hybrid or MAUI template docs for the template claim. The wording can stay.

issues.problem: On macOS, MAUI runs through Mac Catalyst. The answer uses "macOS" here but "Mac Catalyst" in item 1, so the terminology is inconsistent.
issues.suggestedFix: "WKWebView на iOS и Mac Catalyst" (EN: "WKWebView on iOS and Mac Catalyst").
